items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### Audio & Speech

*   [FastScribe](https://fastscribe.org/) - Transcribes podcast audio and video into editable, speaker-labeled text and exports timestamped subtitles as SRT files. `#freemium` `#transcription`

### Chatbots

*   [Whizi](https://whizi.io/) - Chat with GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and Perplexity in one app; switch models mid-chat and import your ChatGPT history. `#paid`

### Customer Support

*   [CallForMe](https://callforme.tel) - Remote MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT or any agent phone a business, wait on hold and bring back a transcript. $1 per answered call. `#paid` `#mcp`

### Design

*   [AIBanner](https://www.aibanner.ai/) - Generate banner images from text prompts and optional reference images with sign-in required. `#paid`
*   [Kite](https://kite.new) - Collaborative design tool where Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex draw editable frames via MCP, exportable as HTML, React or Tailwind. `#freemium` `#design`

### Developer Tools

*   [Apidly Cloud](https://apidly.com/) - Managed GPU servers and serverless GPU endpoints for AI workloads, billed by the second, with a REST API, CLI and SDKs. `#paid` `#api`
*   [DBConvert Studio](https://dbconvert.com/assistant/) - Database migration and synchronization with an AI assistant for connection setup, SQL generation, and job and error explanations; supports local models. `#paid`
*   [DocStar](https://docstar.io) - Turns your product's API into published docs that your users' AI assistants can read and call, through a hosted remote MCP server (<https://mcp.docstar.io/mcp>); reading docs needs no account. `#mcp`
*   [Embarko](https://embarko.ai) - A shared workspace to publish, use and improve anything built with AI; Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients connect through its hosted remote MCP server (<https://mcp.embarko.ai/mcp>, OAuth sign-in). `#mcp`
*   [Excellent for Mac](https://www.excellent.so/) - Reviews recorded coding-agent activity on macOS and can send a masked finding to the user's own agent for explanation. `#freemium`
*   [Novadeck (⭐59)](https://github.com/novadeck-org/novadeck) - Free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and opencode side by side, with every agent's questions and permission asks in one Inbox. `#free` `#opensource`
*   [ReLimit: Monitor](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/relimit-monitor/id6834602625) - macOS utility that compares remaining Codex quota and reset times across saved accounts in a floating window, with live updates for the signed-in account. `#paid`
*   [Runheed](https://runheed.com/) - Error tracking your coding agent can read over MCP: stack traces and breadcrumbs in, fix and resolve out. Paid, 7-day trial. `#paid` `#mcp`
*   [Scalekit](https://www.scalekit.com/) - AI agent integrations platform and MCP gateway that connects AI agents to 1,100+ apps and 55,000+ tools, with each call made on behalf of the end user, tools scoped per agent and every call logged. `#freemium`
*   [ViaSocket](https://viasocket.com/) - Infrastructure for building apps and AI agents, with integrations, automation and AI capabilities, through its hosted remote MCP server (<https://connect.viasocket.com/mcp>, OAuth sign-in). `#mcp`

### E-Commerce

*   [Caspa AI](https://www.caspa.ai/) - AI product photos and videos for online stores, from one product photo. `#paid`
*   [Car Listing Check](https://aicarvideo.com/mcp/) - Remote MCP server (no account, no API key) that checks a car dealer's vehicle listing for completeness and presentation and returns a score with prioritized fixes; endpoint <https://mcp.aicarvideo.com/mcp>. `#free` `#mcp` `#opensource`

### Education

*   [Math Solver](https://bestlatestapps.com/ai/math-solver/) - Solves algebra and calculus step by step in the browser, checks each answer, and can explain the steps with an optional on-device AI model. `#free` `#education`
*   [ModuMath](https://math.hjinlabs.com/?lang=en) - Read the step where a math problem gets difficult, then try a related problem. New accounts receive ten trial credits. `#education` `#math`

### Human Resources

*   [Greetigo](https://greetigo.com/employee-birthday-tracker) - Keeps a small team's birthdays and work anniversaries and emails the manager the day before and on the day, with an AI-drafted message ready. `#freemium`

### Image Editing

*   [Free Image Upscaler](https://free-image-upscaler.web-free.site/) - Upscale photos and anime art 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN running in your browser (WebGPU/WASM); no upload, no sign-up. `#free` `#photo`
*   [Reletter](https://aiedittextinimage.com/) - Replace existing text in screenshots, menus, and product photos using browser OCR and optional AI redraws. `#freemium`

### Music

*   [Flow Music AI](https://flowmusicai.pro/) - Generate vocal songs and instrumentals from prompts or original lyrics with sign-in required. `#paid`

### Research

*   [QuestionPunk](https://www.questionpunk.com/) - Survey platform with AI-moderated voice and chat interviews that ask follow-up questions, plus response reports and cross-tabs. `#freemium`
*   [Scigantic MCP (⭐1)](https://github.com/Scigantic/scigantic-mcp) - MCP server that lets AI assistants search 8,000+ public scientific datasets and read each one's file formats, columns, sample rows and loading code. Hosted at `https://api.scigantic.com/mcp` with no key. `#free` `#mcp` `#opensource`

### Resume

*   [CareerBldr](https://careerbldr.com/) - AI resume builder that tailors your resume to a job post, checks ATS fit and writes cover letters. `#paid`
*   [Headshot Photo Check](https://www.profilfoto-ki.de/mcp) - Remote MCP server (no account, no API key) that technically checks profile and job-application photos (resolution, lighting, sharpness, crop) and returns a score with prioritized tips, without judging the person; endpoint <https://mcp.profilfoto-ki.de/mcp>. `#free` `#mcp` `#opensource`

### SEO

*   [CiteReady](https://cite.shipbastion.com) - No-signup AI search (GEO) auditor checking 10 AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), validating and generating `/llms.txt`, and scoring Schema.org JSON-LD Entity Graphs with free live `/robots-builder` and `/schema-builder` tools. `#freemium` `#seo`

### Sales

*   [Leadsets](https://www.leadsets.ai/) - Unlimited B2B Contact Data for AI Agents, Starting from $29/mo: people and company search, enrichment and work email verification over MCP or REST. `#mcp` `#freemium`

### Travel

*   [Latino Events MCP (⭐0)](https://github.com/AlonDrilich/latino-events-mcp) - Hosted MCP server for events.lat: search upcoming concerts, festivals and cultural events across Latin America by city, country, category and date, with venue, price and ticket page. Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in with an events.lat account. `#free` `#mcp`

### Video

*   [CutVoke (⭐49)](https://github.com/frankShan001/CutVoke) - Local-first desktop video editor where Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client edits the same multi-track timeline you finish by hand. `#free` `#opensource`
*   [Ziztu Clip Maker](https://getziztu.com/clipper) - Turns YouTube, Twitch and Kick streams (up to 10 hours) into vertical clips with word-timed captions, hook titles and facecam layouts. `#paid`

items.title: Discount for Student Dev
items.content_text:
### Web Hosting

*   [Simafri VPS for Students](https://www.simafri.com/en/free-vps-for-students/) \[FREE] - Free VPS (1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, root SSH) for 10 months for students whose school partners with Fondation Simafri; the school confirms enrollment.

### Lists and trackers

*   [Student Offers (⭐7)](https://github.com/ATSDopi/TheStudentRepo) \[FREE] - An international list of student discounts, credits, freebies and free tools, sorted by category and country (65+ countries). Each offer states its verification method (SheerID, UNiDAYS, Student Beans, GitHub Education, ISIC) and each category splits student-gated offers from a free-for-everyone tier. A weekly link-check keeps it maintained.

items.title: Awesome Bitcoin
items.content_text:
### Utilities

*   [btc-toolkit (⭐5)](https://github.com/devdavidejesus/btc-toolkit) - Zero-dependency Python CLI to read and verify Bitcoin from the terminal: OP\_RETURN messages and inscriptions, raw transaction decoding, offline address validation, and Merkle-proof verification against the block's proof of work. Install with pip, pipx, uv or Homebrew.
*   [Kandle (⭐18)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/kandle) - Open-source browser charting app for Bitcoin and other crypto, stocks and forex, with live exchange data, indicators, drawing tools, alerts, bar replay and scripted strategy backtests.
*   [Iris](https://iriscan.app/) - Bitcoin address investigation: who funded an address, its counterparties and where the coins went, including through Wasabi, Whirlpool and JoinMarket CoinJoins, with a cited source for each label.

### Blockchain Explorers

*   [SoChain](https://sochain.com/btc) - Block explorer and API for Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin and Zcash.

### Additional Resources

*   [IoT Financial](https://iotfinancial.net/) - Free guides and open-formula tools for small companies holding bitcoin: allocation sizing, custody options and a treasury policy generator (UK and US).

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Reading and Writing Tools / Text Editors

*   [Umbra](https://umbraeditor.com/) - Native macOS code editor with a built-in coding agent and integrated debugging. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/alex-cova/Penumbra) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

*   [Shotbox](https://box.gatheon.com) - Menu bar screenshot tool that reads the text in every capture on-device, titles it automatically and lets you find it later by any word in the image; includes scrolling capture. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/depthsky2016/shotbox) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### AI Tools / Other Tools

*   [Rakazo](https://rakazo.com) - Open-source app for running self-hosted AI agents with their own computers, memory, and scheduled tasks. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Clipboard Tools

*   [CoPanda](https://www.copanda.app/) - Open-source clipboard manager with a searchable local history, no account and no telemetry. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/rgdevment/CopyPaste) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Productivity

*   [Seawall](https://seawall.work/?utm_source=awesome-mac\&utm_medium=listing) - Menu bar app that locks distracting sites and apps until a set time, with a wait if you leave early. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/NikOneZ1/seawall) ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Window Management

*   [ordino](https://ordino-app.github.io/ordino/) - Menu bar app that arranges every window on the display with one keystroke, with layouts that adapt to the window count and screen shape. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ordino-app/ordino) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [WinPlug](https://winplug.app/) - Windows-style taskbar with window previews, Alt-Tab between windows, snipping tool and Ctrl shortcuts in one app for people switching from Windows.

### DNS

  • koruworks/mono (⭐46) - Koru, a free, open source workspace for notes, documents and AI. Native desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, built on Loro CRDTs and iroh, with free end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer sync
